en: A vintage black‑and‑white (tinted with red title text) postcard view of a calm river with reflections of riverside buildings and wooded hills. On the left foreground is a small rowboat; on the right a covered motorboat moves along the river. On the opposite bank stand several multi‑story houses or hotels built directly by the water, backed by a steep, tree‑covered slope. At the top left of the card there is printed red German text identifying the location as Bad Kösen and describing this riverside section on the Saale near the Loreley.
